title: release builds must not log: debug logging only in test/dev builds
body:
Requested 2026-10-08 while removing CrashReporter (3b2be55).

**What.** Debug logging (`AppLogger`, the on-device log file at `filesDir/logs/app.log`) must exist only in test/dev builds. A release build, which is what Light builds and signs and what users run, must not write it, must not carry the setting, and must not have the code path.

**State today.** `CrashReporter` and its "Report Crashes" toggle are gone. What is left: `AppLogger` (`data/AppLogger.kt`) installs an uncaught-exception handler and writes `app.log`; it is driven by the stored `debugLoggingEnabled` setting (`data/AppSettingsRepository.kt:78-83`, default `true`), mirrored by `AppGraph.kt:89-91` into `AppLogger.setEnabled` and `AppDebugPrefs`. There is no UI to change it, so in a release build it is always on and cannot be turned off. Call sites of `AppLogger.d/e` are throughout `data/` and the screens.

**Why.** Light's tool guidelines: no analytics, tracking or collecting of user data. A local log that records server titles and ids, stack traces and paths, always on and unchangeable, is data kept for no user-facing purpose.

**How (to decide in the work).** Light's builder reads only `tool/src/main`, builds `assembleRelease` unsigned, and rejects a custom manifest and some build-script patterns, so the switch has to be one the SDK build allows:
- `BuildConfig.DEBUG` (the `buildConfig = true` flag is already on) gating `AppLogger` so the release build never opens the file, installs the handler, or reads the setting. R8 (`isMinifyEnabled = true` in release) can then drop the dead branches.
- Or split the logger: a no-op `AppLogger` for release with the real one under `src/debug` (note the builder ignores `src/debug`, so this only works if the no-op is the one in `src/main`; check this against the builder).
- Remove the `debugLoggingEnabled` setting, its mirror and `AppDebugPrefs` outright if the logger no longer needs a runtime switch in debug either (overlaps #89 "declare a setting once").

**Done when:** a release APK built the way Light's server builds it (`:tool:assembleRelease -DlightSdk.unsigned=true`) writes no `app.log`, installs no uncaught-exception handler, and has no debug-logging setting; a debug build still logs as before. Verify by installing both on the phone and listing `files/logs/`.

Related: #89 (settings), docs/WORK-architecture-review-2.md (S5).
